title: Allgemeinverfügung erlassen – Einschränkungen im Bezirk Mitte

extraction.placeName: Gedenkort für Polen 1939 – 1945, Platz der Republik
extraction.summaryEn: General order (Allgemeinverfügung) with security measures and traffic closures in the government district around the Tiergarten on 1 September 2026, for a commemoration of the German invasion of Poland. Entry is limited to residents and authorised persons, and parking is banned in the area.
